other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage / Train-Test Feature Mismatch
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes lag features using true target values for the validation set (since lags are computed on the full training set before splitting). However, for the test set, it falls back to global means or zeros because true targets are unavailable. This causes a massive feature distribution mismatch where the model relies on strong lag features during validation that are missing during inference, leading to overly optimistic validation scores and poor test performance.

other_failure_modes.name: Destructive Data Cleaning
other_failure_modes.description: The agent attempts to clean string categorical columns by coercing them to numeric types and filling missing values with 0. For columns that contain string values (e.g. 'Yes'/'No' or 'Holiday'/'No Holiday'), this blindly converts all valid string values to NaNs and then to 0, completely destroying the features.

summary: The agent sets up a robust time-based split and implements extensive feature engineering. However, it introduces critical target leakage into the validation set by computing lag features on the full training set prior to splitting, creating a severe train-test feature mismatch. Additionally, its data cleaning approach destructively coerces string categorical features to 0, completely losing their information.
